segments.name: Power semiconductors
segments.description: Designs, develops and globally supplies a broad portfolio of power semiconductors for computing, consumer electronics, communication and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized as, and operates in, one operating segment: the design, development and supply of power semiconductor products for computing, consumer electronics, communication and industrial applications.

revenueModel.text: The company sells its power semiconductor products primarily to distributors in the Asia Pacific region, who in turn sell to end customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company sells its products primarily to distributors in the Asia Pacific region, who in turn sell these products to end customers.
